gate.score: mean(model_abs_error - previous_settlement_day_reference_abs_error) over latest completed outcomes available by decision time

information_rule: For each target, an outcome may enter gate history only when target_start_utc + 30 minutes <= the current decision_time_utc. The current target and all future targets are excluded.
development_interpretation: The rule was designed after inspecting v0.24 monitoring through 2026-08-21T11:00Z. Any replay on those rows is retrospective development evidence only.
forward_interpretation: Only target starts at or after 2026-08-21T11:30Z that were not inspected before this specification was frozen may be labelled v0.25 forward evidence.
claim_boundary: This candidate is an adaptive trust/fallback policy around the unchanged frozen 2h forecaster. It is not a new price model and historical development diagnostics are not fresh prospective evidence.
